scientific_integrity: Exact algebraic classification over algebraically closed fields of characteristic at least five; finite checks do not replace proof. No independent external review.
scientific_limitations: Only the parameter open set (a+b+3)(a^2+ab+b^2) != 0 is classified; no claim for the complement or for arithmetic point counts.
title: The four-node and ten-singularity strata of the generalized Wiman–Edge sextic
